description: Take rate fee vectors: the fee cap and its rounding, the charge against mandate limits, the fee outside the daily cap, lowering the cap, and the fee address paid only by execute and holding no role.

vectors.description: A total of 123456 at 100 bps carries a fee of exactly its cap of 1234, reserves 124690 and pays 123456 to bob and 1234 to the fee address.
A fee one unit over its cap is FEE_EXCEEDS_CAP for small and huge totals, before the per payment cap, and the same IDs pass at the cap.
A total of 10^38 + 9999 at 100 bps, where total times bps would overflow i128, has a cap of 10^36 + 99, and a fee at that cap is paid.
At 50 bps the cap rounds down: 199 allows 0, 200 allows 1, 10000 allows 50 and 19999 allows 99, and each fee at its cap is paid.
At 50 bps a fee of 1 on 199, 50 on 9999, 51 on 10000 and 100 on 19999 are each one over the rounded down cap and refused.
With max_fee_bps 0 a fee of 1 is refused on any total, and the same payout with no fee is paid with nothing to the fee address.
create accepts max_fee_bps 100, both creation events name the factory's fee address, and a fee of 1 percent is then paid to it.
create refuses max_fee_bps 101 and the largest u32 with CONFIG_INVALID, which comes before a fee address role conflict in the same config.
With 990 of the budget left, a total of 982 that fits alone is BUDGET_EXCEEDED with its fee of 9, and 981 plus 9 uses the budget exactly.
Total plus fee one over the per payment cap is refused at request and, after the cap is lowered under the charge, at execute.
With the threshold at 1000, a total of 991 plus a fee of 9 is PENDING while 990 plus 9 is APPROVED, and both are paid after approval.
With a daily cap of 1000, two payouts of 500 each with a fee of 5 are paid and the recipient's usage is exactly 1000, never 1010.
With 1000 free, 992 plus a fee of 9 is INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, and after a clawback of 1 the balance covers the total of 991 but not the charge.
A payout with the four legs MAX_LEGS allows also carries a fee, which is not a leg, and each leg and the fee are paid exactly.
Rejecting a pending payout of 1000 with a fee of 10 releases all 1010 and moves no tokens, whether an approver or the principal rejects.
Cancels by the principal, by the agent and of a lapsed payout by anyone each release total plus fee and move no tokens.
Lowering the cap to 50 bps stops a queued fee of 10 on 1000 at execute, ahead of a lowered per payment cap, while a queued fee of 5 is paid.
lower_fee_cap refuses the current value and any higher one with CONFIG_INVALID, lowers 50 to 49 and then to 0, after which any fee is refused.
The principal lowers the fee cap while the mandate is paused and again once it has expired.
Only the principal lowers the cap: the agent, a guardian, a recovery approver and the fee address are refused, and after revoke so is the principal.
A fee above I128_MAX minus the total is AMOUNT_INVALID, including total I128_MAX with fee 1, while a fee of exactly that difference reaches the fee cap.
A total of I128_MAX minus 1 with a fee of 1 charges exactly I128_MAX, is approved and paid, and spent reaches I128_MAX.
A fee of -1 and a fee of the i128 minimum are AMOUNT_INVALID; only a Stellar i128 can carry them.
A fee of I128_MAX plus 1, of 2^128 and of 39 nines is AMOUNT_INVALID; only a Celo uint256 argument can carry them.
The fee address balance rises by exactly the fee on execute and by nothing on request, approval, withdraw, revoke or sweep.
While the fee address is deauthorized an execute with a fee is TRANSFER_FAILED and pays nothing; cancelled and requested again with fee 0 it is paid.
With no trustline at the fee address an execute with a fee is TRANSFER_FAILED and changes nothing; once it can receive, the same execute pays.
create refuses the fee address as principal, agent, approver, guardian, executor or recovery approver, then creates with it outside every role.
add_role of the fee address for each of the five roles, proposing it as principal and rotating it in as an agent are all ROLE_CONFLICT.
The fee address cannot request, approve, execute or withdraw, and its balance rises only when the agent executes a payout with a fee.
The fee address cannot be allowlisted with or without a tag or paid as a leg, even a leg the size of the fee, so it receives only the fee.
A batch item over the fee cap is rejected alone, and after the cap is lowered an execute batch reverts whole on the item now over it.
